subject: V5 live convergence: three Codex failures, healthy Claude, tight disk

observations: V5 admitted 3 Codex and 2 Claude epochs concurrently at startup.
All three Codex epochs exited rc=1 after roughly 12-14 seconds and entered transient cooldown.
Both Claude epochs remained active after the Codex failures.
Background ExtremeGC raised free disk from about 2.38 GiB to about 2.92 GiB but the system remains tight.
The two seeded remote mesh events already existed in local EventGraph state, so remote imported=0 is consistent with deduplication and is not by itself a mesh failure.
Docker probe reported unavailable, so volume pruning did not execute despite the operator flag.
required_actions: Inspect the three failed Codex epoch stderr/command records locally and identify the shared cause before retrying them.
If the cause is supervisor invocation or environment construction, patch the live Bonfyre Run8 machinery and add a regression proof rather than merely retrying.
Continue useful Claude/native work while Codex is cooling; do not collapse the run.
Find substantially larger reclaim classes than tiny bytecode caches while preserving active execution environments and current canonical authority.
Emit a sanitized review_result, trace_divergence, or handoff back through the mesh with evidence references; do not expose raw logs or local paths.
body.compounding_rule: Every solved operational defect should become a SolvedInvariant plus RegressionFence and should spawn one cross-provider adversarial check before being considered mature.
